policy: A Hermes chat feature is complete only when Android and macOS implement it, the capability contract is updated, and parity tests pass.

capabilities.title: Profiles are loaded from Cloudflare and are never hard-coded
One long-lived WebSocket routes every configured profile
Android and macOS can stay online together for one account
Messages sent by either native client appear on the other client
Messages, actions, and attachments use compatible AES-256-GCM envelopes
Each profile key is isolated in platform secure storage
Local history snapshots remain encrypted and profile-isolated
Reconnect resumes after the local durable sequence instead of pulling all history
Hermes stream edits update one existing bubble
Connection, typing, and awaiting-response state are visible per conversation
Inactive profiles display local unread counts
Message search runs only against the local cache
Telegram-style Markdown and fenced code blocks include copy actions
Command palette and inline suggestions share the Hermes messaging catalog
Encrypted model, approval, and clarification buttons execute over WebSocket
Both clients accept the same image, media, document, Office, archive, and package formats
Attachment cards visibly distinguish file categories
Images can be enlarged, shared, and saved
Encrypted audio and video can be played on demand
Documents and archives can be opened, shared, and saved
Text can be copied/shared/saved and one or many messages can be deleted
Local encrypted caches and Cloudflare message/attachment data can be cleaned per profile
Navigation or backgrounding does not intentionally release the process-level socket
